assumptions: For k equal-frequency canonical bosonic modes with H=hbar omega sum a_i^dagger a_i, initially tau_n tensor k at a sole preparation reservoir T>0, all Hamiltonians return to H. An arbitrary final state rho (not assumed Gaussian) has N_ij=Tr(rho a_j^dagger a_i), N_ii=n. A balanced rank-r orthogonal projector P has P_ii=r/k, 1<=r<k, and PNP<=nu P for 0<=nu<n. Put b=(kn-r nu)/(k-r) and g(x)=(x+1)ln(x+1)-x ln x. The source internally proves S(rho)<=r g(nu)+(k-r)g(b) and the exact minimum free-energy increase W_bal=k_B T[k g(n)-r g(nu)-(k-r)g(b)]. The bound is attained by a gauge-invariant Gaussian state N_star=nu P+b(I-P), with hot thermal local marginals. Historical novelty of this specialization of established principles is UNKNOWN.

In a finite undirected network with supplied c_e>0 and terminals A,B, an admissible potential u_A=0,u_B=1 orients an exactly conserved unit flow j_e>=0 along strictly positive drops Delta_e. No incoming flow at A or outgoing flow at B is allowed; zero-drop edges require zero flow. Discrete integration by parts gives sum j_e Delta_e=1. Draw a path by normalized outgoing flows, then a uniform potential level: its crossing edge has q_e=j_e Delta_e. Acquiring/checking the graph, outgoing tables, conservation, monotonicity and paths is charged; explicit input generally costs O(|E|). This reconstructs classical principles, not a new variational theorem.

An acquisition oracle supplies iid X in R^d with a known certified almost-sure bound ||X||<=R and unknown mu=E X. Each acquisition costs C_X including generation and reading all coordinates; ideal Gaussian/uniform reals and exact arithmetic are explicit primitives. For 0<epsilon<1, the source constructs Y with entire-law TV(Law(Y),N(mu,I_d))<=epsilon, expected oracle count <=2e^2 m, O(dm) arithmetic and O(d) memory, where m=ceil[64(1+R^2)ln(64(1+R^2)/epsilon)]. The ideal expected acquisition-inclusive cost is O((C_X+d)(1+R^2)ln((1+R^2)/epsilon)); R=0 needs no oracle calls. This is internally reconstructed known mathematics, not a fresh capability claim.
